presets.name: Homewrecker Burrito
presets.blurb: Moe's OG burrito: fresh guacamole, rice, beans, shredded cheese, romaine, pico de gallo and sour cream in a 12" flour tortilla. Moe's publishes 810 cal as the base WITHOUT protein — add your protein on top.
presets.sourceNote: Composition from https://assets.ctfassets.net/zqt8tllj2cy0/229Bgcvw5c0RwcUkhyghXG/d3722a14b4b1dd925316a8936200f5bd/MOES_1906368_Nutrition_Chart_2026_R4.pdf (fetched 2026-08-07). Verified against the published 810 kcal (ours 805).

presets.name: Homewrecker Bowl
presets.blurb: The OG burrito in a bowl: guacamole, rice, beans, shredded cheese, romaine, pico de gallo and sour cream. Moe's publishes 650 cal as the base WITHOUT protein — add your protein on top.
presets.sourceNote: Composition from https://assets.ctfassets.net/zqt8tllj2cy0/229Bgcvw5c0RwcUkhyghXG/d3722a14b4b1dd925316a8936200f5bd/MOES_1906368_Nutrition_Chart_2026_R4.pdf (fetched 2026-08-07). Verified against the published 650 kcal (ours 645), 23g protein (ours 21).

presets.name: Moe Protein Bowl
presets.blurb: Rice, beans, Moe's Famous Queso, pico de gallo, Oaxaca cheese and a double portion of protein. Moe's advertises 'up to 61g of protein' — reached with White Meat Chicken Double, which is what this build uses.
presets.sourceNote: Composition from https://assets.ctfassets.net/zqt8tllj2cy0/229Bgcvw5c0RwcUkhyghXG/d3722a14b4b1dd925316a8936200f5bd/MOES_1906368_Nutrition_Chart_2026_R4.pdf (fetched 2026-08-07). Verified against the published 870 kcal (ours 850), 61g protein (ours 60).
